The '''Desert Diary''' is an [[Achievement Diary]] whose tasks revolve around areas within the [[Kharidian Desert]], such as [[Pollnivneach]], [[Nardah]], and [[Sophanem]].

Several skill, quest, and item requirements are needed to complete all tasks. Unless stated otherwise, [[temporary skill boost]]s can be used to meet the skill requirements.

Rewards can be claimed from [[Jarr]] in the [[Shantay Pass]]. Tasks may be done in any order, but the previous tiers of a diary must be completed to claim rewards of the next tier.

==Easy==
{| class="wikitable lighttable qc-active diary-table" style=width:750px; data-diary-name="Desert" data-diary-tier="Easy"
! style="width:50%;" | Task
! style="width:50%;" | Requirements
|-
|1. Catch a [[Golden Warbler]].
|
*{{SCP|Hunter|5|link=y}}
*[[Bird snare]]
*[[Necklace of passage]] recommended for quick access to Eagle's Eyrie, near the [[Uzer Hunter area]]
|-
|2. Mine 5 [[clay]] in the [[Uzer mine|north-eastern desert]].
|
*Any [[pickaxe]]
*[[Necklace of passage]] recommended for quick access to Eagle's Eyrie, near the [[Uzer mine]]
|-
|3. Enter the [[Kalphite Lair|Kalphite Hive]].
|
*[[Rope]]
|-
|4. Enter the [[Desert]] with a set of [[Desert clothing|Desert robes]] equipped.
''Note: Not to be confused with the [[desert outfit]], which doesn't count for this task. You also cannot use the [[black desert shirt]] or [[black desert robe]].
|
*[[Desert shirt]], [[desert robe]], and [[desert boots]]
|-
|5. Kill a [[Vulture]]
''Note: These are found north of [[Menaphos]] or [[Sophanem]].''
|
*[[Weaponry]], preferably [[Ranged]] or [[Magic]]
|-
|6. Have the [[Zahur|Nardah Herbalist]] clean a [[Herb]] for you.
''Note: You have to talk to Zahur to complete this task. Do not use the grimy herb on her to clean it.''
|
*Any [[grimy herb]] and 200 [[coins]]
|-
|7. Collect 5 [[Potato Cactus]]{{sic}} from the [[Kalphite Lair|Kalphite Hive]].
''Note: You can bring a single [[potato cactus]] to the lair, then drop and pick it up five times.''
|
*[[Rope]]
*[[Antipoison]] and [[food]] recommended if not bringing your own [[potato cactus]]
|-
|8. Sell some artefacts to [[Simon Templeton]].
''Note: The [[pyramid top]] from the nearby [[Agility Pyramid]] does not count.''
|
* Players must have started [[Icthlarin's Little Helper]] for access to [[Sophanem]].

*Any [[Pyramid_Plunder#Rewards|artefact]] from [[Pyramid Plunder]].
|-
|9. Open the [[Sarcophagus_(Pyramid_Plunder)|Sarcophagus]] in the first room of [[Pyramid Plunder]]
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Started [[Icthlarin's Little Helper]]
*{{SCP|Thieving|21|link=y}}
|-
|10. Cut a [[Kharidian cactus|desert cactus]] open to fill a [[waterskin]].
|
*[[Knife]] or a slash weapon, and an empty [[waterskin]]
|-
|11. Travel from the [[Shantay Pass]] to [[Pollnivneach]] by [[Magic Carpet]].
|
*200 [[coins]] and a [[Shantay pass (item)|Shantay Pass]] or another 5 coins.
|}

===Rewards===
*[[Desert amulet 1]]:
**No benefits aside from cosmetic purposes
*[[Antique lamp (easy)|Antique lamp]] worth 2,500 experience in any skill of at least level 30
*[[Pharaoh's sceptre]] will now hold up to 10 [[Pharaoh's sceptre#Recharging|charges]], up from 3
*[[Goat horn]]s from [[goat]]s are now [[Bank note|noted]]
*[[Simon Templeton]] now also buys artefacts in [[Bank note|noted]] form

==Medium==
{| class="wikitable lighttable qc-active diary-table" style=width:750px; data-diary-name="Desert" data-diary-tier="Medium"
! style="width:50%;" | Task
! style="width:50%;" | Requirements

*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Spirits of the Elid]]

|8. Create a [[combat potion]] in the [[desert]].
|

|

''Note: [[Teak tree]]s are found north-east of the oasis.''

*Any [[axe]]
|}

===Rewards===
*[[Desert amulet 2]]:
**One daily teleport to [[Nardah]]
*[[Antique lamp (medium)|Antique lamp]] worth 7,500 experience in any skill of at least level 40
*[[Pharaoh's sceptre]] will now hold up to 25 [[Pharaoh's sceptre#Recharging|charges]], up from 10

==Hard==
{| class="wikitable lighttable qc-active diary-table" style=width:750px; data-diary-name="Desert" data-diary-tier="Hard"
! style="width:50%;" | Task
! style="width:50%;" | Requirements
|-
|1. Knock out and [[pickpocket]] a [[Menaphite Thug]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Partial completion of [[The Feud]]
*{{SCP|Thieving|65|link=y}}
*Any [[blackjack]]
|-
|2. Mine some [[Granite]].<ref group="d">Mining granite at the [[Cape Conch mine]] in [[The Great Conch]] will also complete this task.</ref>
|
*{{SCP|Mining|45|link=y}}
*Any [[pickaxe]]
|-
|3. Refill your [[waterskin]]s in the [[Desert]] using [[Lunar spellbook|Lunar magic]].
''Note: The spell must be cast outside of a desert settlement.
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Dream Mentor]]
*{{SCP|Magic|68|link=y}}
*[[Lunar spellbook]] selected
*[[Waterskin]] that isn't full and means to cast [[Humidify]] ({{RuneReq|Astral=1|Fire=1|Water=3}})
|-
|4. Kill the [[Kalphite Queen]].
|
*See the [[Kalphite_Queen/Strategies|strategy guide]]
|-
|5. Complete a lap of the [[Pollnivneach Rooftop Course|Pollnivneach agility course]].
|
*{{SCP|Agility|70|link=y}}
|-
|6. Slay a [[Dust Devil]] in the [[Smoke Dungeon|desert cave]] with a [[Slayer helmet]] equipped.
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Started [[Desert Treasure I]]
*{{SCP|Slayer|65|link=y}} {{Boostable|y}} and {{SCP|Defence|10|link=y}}
*[[Slayer helmet]] (requires {{SCP|Crafting|55|link=y}} {{Boostable|y}}) (and {{SCP|Quest}} completion of [[Cabin Fever]] for [[Ironman mode|Ironman accounts]])
|-
|7. Activate [[Ancient Magicks]] at the [[Altar_(Ancient_Pyramid)|altar]] in the [[Ancient Pyramid|Jaldraocht Pyramid]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Desert Treasure I]]
|-
|8. Defeat a [[Locust Rider]] with [[Keris]].
''Note: This weapon only has to be equipped as it dies, allowing you to deal damage with other weapons. [[Keris partisan]] and its variants also work for completing this task.
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Partial completion of [[Contact!]]
*{{SCP|Attack|50|link=y}}
*[[Keris]] or [[Keris partisan]], and any [[light source]]
|-
|9. Burn some [[yew logs]] on the [[Nardah Mayor]]'s balcony.
''Note: He lives directly east of the central fountain.
|
*{{SCP|Firemaking|60|link=y}}
*[[Yew log]] and a [[tinderbox]]
|-
|10. Create a [[Mithril Platebody]] in [[Nardah]].
''Note: The anvil is found in the westernmost building.
|
*{{SCP|Smithing|68|link=y}}
*5 [[mithril bar]]s and a [[hammer]]
|}
{{Reflist|group=d}}

===Rewards===
*[[Desert amulet 3]]:
**No new benefits
*[[Antique lamp (hard)|Antique lamp]] worth 15,000 experience in any skill of at least level 50
*[[Pharaoh's sceptre]] will now hold up to 50 [[Pharaoh's sceptre#Recharging|charges]], up from 25
*Free [[carpet ride]]s throughout the [[Kharidian Desert]], down from a fee of 75-200 [[coins]] per ride
*[[Rope]]s are now permanently secured once placed at the [[Kalphite Lair]] entrance and [[Kalphite Queen|Queen's Lair]]
*Roughly 14% increased experience and 25% more [[mark of grace|marks of grace]] from the [[Pollnivneach Rooftop Course]]{{CiteDiscord|author=Mod Lykos|url=https://discord.com/channels/177206626514632704/514602892292784139/1397002033911038144|date=21 July 2025|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/27962726#chat-messages-514602892292784139-1397002033911038144|archivedate=7 March 2026|quote=for the Pollnivneach and Rellekka courses, there is a 1/3 chance to have the timer be two minutes if you've completed the hard tier of the respective diary|image=Lykos Desert and Frem diary mark of grace bonus.png}}
*[[Camulet]] can now be rubbed to teleport to the entrance of [[Enakhra's Temple]], aside from the inner sanctuary of that temple 
*[[Zahur]] now also cleans [[grimy herb]]s in [[Bank note|noted]] form, and offers her [[Zahur#Unfinished potions|potion-making services]]

==Elite==
{| class="wikitable lighttable qc-active diary-table" style=width:750px; data-diary-name="Desert" data-diary-tier="Elite"
! style="width:50%;" | Task
! style="width:50%;" | Requirements
|-
|1. Bake a [[wild pie]] at the [[Nardah]] [[Clay oven|Clay Oven]].
|
*{{SCP|Cooking|85|link=y}} {{Boostable|y}}
*[[Raw wild pie]]
|-
|2. Cast [[Ice Barrage]] against a foe in the [[Desert]]
''Note: The spell must be cast outside of a desert settlement, and must successfully hit.
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Desert Treasure I]]
*{{SCP|Magic|94|link=y}} {{Boostable|y}}
*Means to cast [[Ice Barrage]] ({{RuneReq|Death=4|Blood=2|Water=6}})
|-
|3. Fletch some [[Dragon dart]]s at the [[Bedabin Camp]].
|
*{{SCP|Fletching|95|link=y}} {{Boostable|y}}
*[[Dragon dart tip]] and [[feather]]
|-
|4. Speak to the [[Kalphite Queen head (mounted)|KQ head]] in your [[POH]].
''Note: The [[Kalphite Queen]] has a 1/128 chance of dropping her [[Kq head|head]] on death, and is guaranteed to drop a [[kq head (tattered)|tattered head]] on the 256th kill, both of which can be used to create the [[Kalphite Queen head (mounted)|KQ head]].''
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Priest in Peril]]
*{{SCP|Construction|78|link=y}} {{Boostable|y}}
*2 [[mahogany plank]]s, 2 [[gold leaves]], [[saw]], and [[hammer]]
*[[Kq head]] or [[Kq head (tattered)]], and 50,000 [[coins]] to have the [[taxidermist]] [[Stuffed_kq_head|stuff]] it
*Additional 15,000 [[coins]] to construct a [[Hall_(skill_trophies)|Skill Hall]] if you haven't already
|-
|5. Steal from the [[Grand Gold Chest]] in the final room of [[Pyramid Plunder]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Started [[Icthlarin's Little Helper]]
*{{SCP|Thieving|91|link=y}} {{Boostable|n}}
|-
|6. Restore at least 85 [[Prayer points]] when praying at the [[Altar (Sophanem)|Altar]] in [[Sophanem]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Started [[Icthlarin's Little Helper]]
*{{SCP|Prayer|85|link=y}} {{Boostable|n}}
|}

===Rewards===
*[[Desert amulet 4]]:
**Unlimited teleports to [[Nardah]], closer to the [[Elidinis Statuette]] than the previous amulets
**Unlimited teleports to the entrance of the [[Kalphite Cave]]
**Fully protects against [[desert heat]] while worn
*[[Antique lamp (elite)|Antique lamp]] worth 50,000 experience in any skill of at least level 70
*[[Pharaoh's sceptre]] will now hold up to 100 [[Pharaoh's sceptre#Recharging|charges]], up from 50
*Free passage through [[Shantay Pass]] and the similar pass at [[Ruins of Unkah]], down from a fee of 5 [[coins]]
*Access to the [[Crevice (Kalphite Lair)|crevice shortcut]] in the [[Kalphite Lair]] (with 86 [[Agility]])

==Trivia==
* When a player who has completed the hard Desert diary downgrades their Ironman status to a main account, the Pollivneach house task is marked as incomplete. However, the diary as a whole remains in the state of rewards having been claimed. The task does not need to be completed again to receive the benefits from the hard or elite tiers.
